title: Manifest
description: Manifest of one eval set version. Same shape as validateManifest in packages/evals/src/index.ts; values are computed by computeManifest.

by_category.description: Active cases per category; categories without active cases are omitted.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of every case, retired included, sorted by id (UTF-16 code units); each case as canonical JSON (keys sorted by UTF-16 code units at every level, array order kept) followed by LF.

split_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of id TAB split LF for every case, retired included, sorted by id.
